summary: Bug: Workorder -> "New Line" button is appearing in Blue background color
reported_issue: On the Work Order screen the 'New Line' button appears with a solid blue background. On production it appears with a white background, blue text, and a blue outline.
expected_after_fix: New Line button rendered with white background, blue text color, and a blue outline (matching production).
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin, opened a Work Order and navigated to its Lines tab (/workorders/{id}/lines).
Located the New Line button (data-test-id=button_new_line) and read its computed styles.
Captured a screenshot of the button.
actual_now: The New Line button still renders with a SOLID BLUE background: background-color rgb(56,116,255) (class bg-blue-10), text color rgb(255,255,255) (white), border-width 0px (no outline). This is the buggy appearance described in the ticket, not the expected white-background / blue-text / blue-outline styling.
notes: Ticket has no fixVersion and no Staging_Verified label. The button is a filled blue primary button, matching exactly what the bug reports as wrong. Could not compare against current production styling, so it is possible the design was intentionally standardized to a filled blue primary (which would make this OBSOLETE); however, purely against the ticket's expected state the bug still reproduces.
